body.insert: WHAT IS 4XD ACTS DNA STRATEGIC DISCIPLESHIP?

1. IT IS A MOVEMENT 
From the root word acts, it is an active movement. 
It is The Holy Spirit Movement.

2. . IT IS A REVOLUTION 
It is The Gospel Revolution: started by Jesus, continued by the Apostles and mandated to the Church including us. 

3. IT IS A DISCIPLESHIP MODEL 
It is The 4XDiscipleship Model. 
This is the Discipleship Model of the Holy Spirit in the book of Acts. 

The Church is looking for better methods; God is looking for better men. 
-E.M. Bounds (A Certain Kind) Men are God’s method.

4X DISCIPLES IS A CERTAIN KIND OF DISCIPLES IN THE BOOK OF ACTS

Acts 6:3-4 (NKJV)
3 Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business; 4 but we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”

Acts 6:5-7 (NKJV)
5 And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch, 6 whom they set before the apostles; and when they had prayed, they laid hands on them.
7 Then the word of God spread, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem…

1. Example: Full of IntegrityThis stands for character and holiness (this is the foundation)
Acts 6:3
Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of GOOD REPUTATION...

Good Reputation means Trusted among the people because of their Example of Character.

SO TO GROW IN QUANTITY, FIRST WE MUST GROW IN QUALITY.

1 Timothy 4:12 (NKJV)
Let no one despise your youth, but BE AN EXAMPLE to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

1 Peter 1:14-16 (NLT)
So you MUST LIVE as God’s obedient children. DON’T SLIP BACK into your old ways of living to satisfy your own desires. You didn’t know any better then. 15 But now YOU MUST BE HOLY in everything you do, just as God who chose you is holy. 16 For the Scriptures say, “YOU MUST BE HOLY because I am holy.”

Building A Strong Foundation Is The First Step to Church Expansion.

2. Extraordinary: Full of the Holy SpiritThis stands for power and anointing (gifts)

Acts 6:3
Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, FULL OF THE HOLY SPIRIT...

The Spirit-Filled Disciples Make The Church Grow. (Ex:Stephen, Philip)

1 Corinthians 2:4 (NKJV)
And my speech and my preaching were NOT with PERSUASIVE words of HUMAN WISDOM, but in DEMONSTRATION of the SPIRIT and of POWER.

Power separates the Attractional Church From the Discipleship Church.

1 Corinthians 2:5 (KJV)
That your faith should NOT stand in the wisdom of men, but in the POWER of God.

Paul was a Church Growth Practitioner. He planted a lot of Churches By the POWER OF GOD! 

3. Excellent: Full of Wisdom
This stands for competencies and excellence.
The Spirit within us (the Holy Spirit) is a spirit of Excellence!

Acts 6:3
Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit AND WISDOM ...

Proverbs 4:7 (NIV)
The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom. Though IT COST ALL you have, GET understanding

2 Timothy 1:7 (NKJV)
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a SOUND MIND.

Matthew 10:16 (NKJV)
Behold, I SEND you out as sheep in the midst of WOLVES. Therefore be WISE as serpents and harmless as doves.

Ecclesiastes 10:10 (NIV)
If the axe is dull and its edge unsharpened, more strength is needed, but skill will bring success

A Sharp Axe Cut The Trees QUICKLY And EASILY.  To Finish Your Goal QUICKLY You Must Be Sharp! 

1 Corinthians 15:58
Therefore, my beloved brothers and sisters, be steadfast, immovable, ALWAYS EXCELLING IN THE WORK OF THE LORD...

4. Extreme: Full of FaithThis stands for courage and boldness.
Acts 6:5
And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man FULL OF FAITH ...

All believers suppose to walk by Faith. That’s why we are called Believers!

2 Corinthians 5:7 (NKJV)
For we WALK by faith, not by sight.

Romans 1:17 (NKJV)
For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; as it is written, “The just shall LIVE by faith.”

Joshua 1:9 (NKJV)
Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.


Hebrews 11:32-34 (NLT)
32 How much more do I need to say? It would take too long to recount the stories of the faith of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and all the prophets. 33 By faith these people overthrew kingdoms, ruled with justice, and received what God had promised them. They shut the mouths of lions, 34 quenched the flames of fire, and escaped death by the edge of the sword. Their weakness was turned to strength. They became strong in battle and put whole armies to flight. 

They Changed the world! 

They turned it upside down. 

They live differently.

Dream Big by Faith. 

And by Faith, pay the price.

Conclusion: What is 4XD Acts DNA Strategic Discipleship
